programme.title: Henry VIII: Man, Monarch, Monster
programme.desc: A three part dramatised documentary series examining the one of England's most famous Kings: Henry VIII. The series chronicles his life from young man up to his monstrous later years. After becoming heir to the throne following his elder brother's unexpected death, a young Prince Henry also lost his mother, adding to a growing list of personal tragedy. We follow the young King on his journey as ruler, including the infamous power battle with the Catholic Church and the pursuit of English Reformation, enabling him to re-marry. His extravagant diet that led to many health complications is revealed, as the once fit and athletic King became obese and unhealthy in his later life, adding to his cruel and paranoid character.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. Bolonijos „Virtus Segafredo“ - Stambulo „Anadolu Efes“
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: EuroLeague. Real Madrid - Panathinaikos Aktor Athens
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: LaLiga. Rayo Vallecano - Real Madrid
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Vimbldonas. Official Film
programme.desc: Wimbledon is more than just a tennis tournament — it's a summer tradition, a slice of British culture, and one of the most iconic sporting events in the world. Held every year in London, England, usually in late June to early July, it's where the best tennis players on the planet come to battle it out on the famous grass courts of the All England Club. It's actually the oldest tennis tournament in the world, dating back to 1877, and it's still the only Grand Slam played on grass — the fastest and most unpredictable surface. That's part of what makes it so exciting. Matches are intense, fast-paced, and full of surprises. Wimbledon is packed with unique traditions that make it stand out. Players are required to wear all white on court — no exceptions. The crowd enjoys strawberries and cream, and you won't see flashy ads around the court — it's all about the game. And of course, there's the Royal Box, where you might spot celebrities or even members of the British Royal Family watching the action. From rising stars to tennis legends, everyone dreams of lifting the famous Wimbledon trophy. There's something magical about seeing players walk onto Centre Court, hearing the roar of the crowd, and witnessing moments that go down in sports history. Whether you're a tennis fan or just love great sports drama, Wimbledon is a must-watch — classy, thrilling, and full of unforgettable moments.

programme.title: Equator's Wild Secrets

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: British author, television presenter and wildlife expert, Nigel Marven, travels the world to find the deadliest species of snake. In each episode Marven travels to a new country or continent and reveals the top 10 deadliest snakes that inhabit that region. From Costa Rica's black-headed bushmaster to South Africa's infamous black mamba, China's king cobra to Mexico's terciopelo, we uncover the most dangerous snakes on our planet. Known for his bold and impulsive approach to animals in the wild, Marven must be on full alert, as a bite from these slithering serpents could paralyse or even kill him.

programme.title: Hunt for the Giant Squid

We really can shine some light on the enduring mystery of the giant squid - and perhaps even find one. programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

Raph is the oldest of the brothers and also their leader. Leo is the sword-swinging trickster of the team. Donnie is the smartest of the group and Mikey is the youngest brother and also the joker of the bunch. The adventures they go on help them discover their mystic ninja powers and understand the world around them. They learn to work better as a team of heroes. Skills they will need when faced with the enemies who wish to defeat the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles.

programme.title: T.U.F.F. Puppy
programme.desc: Thunder Dog:Kitty helps Dudley to get rid of his fear of thunder in order to stop Bird Brain from using his thunder cannon to bury Petropolis in an avalanche by using a necklace.Snap Dad:Snaptrap and Dudley's mother, Peg, have fallen in love. Things couldn't get any worse, or so Dudley thinks, until Snaptrap is inspired by his new girlfriend to turn a new leaf upside down and becomes the newest member of T.U.F.F.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: SpongeBob SquarePants is a cartoon series starring the yellow sea sponge Spongebob who lives deep in the ocean in the underwater town called Bikini Bottom. Together with his buddy the pink starfish Patrick, he experiences the craziest and most exciting adventures. Spongebob has a very energetic and optimistic character and works as a chef in restaurant "The Krusty Krab" where he makes the best burgers of the bottom of the sea.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

In un mondo interamente abitato da animali, il koala Buster Moon possiede uno storico teatro caduto ormai in disgrazia dopo i fasti del passato. Per risollevarne le sorti, organizza una gara di canto radunando una serie di incredibili aspiranti star. A contendersi la palma del migliore ci sono Mike, un topolino imbroglione, la timida elefantessa Meena e Rosita, una scrofa con 25 maialini da accudire. E poi Johnny e Ash: il primo e' un gorilla figlio di un gangster; la seconda e' una grintosa cantante punk.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire - Mammo per sempre
programme.desc: Uno dei personaggi piu' riusciti del grande Robin Williams, che scatena la sua comicita' in abiti femminili. Per stare vicino ai suoi tre figli dei quali ha perso l'affidamento dopo il divorzio, Daniel si traveste da governante e si fa assumere dall'ex moglie, interpretata dal premio Oscar Sally Field, che gli impedisce di vederli. Irriconoscibile, diventa cosi' Mrs. Doubtfire e puo' occuparsi dei tre ragazzi che si affezionano a 'lei'. Oscar per il miglior trucco. Dal regista di "Mamma ho perso l'aereo", nel cast anche Pierce Brosnan.

programme.title: Dolcissime

Nasce Dog Man, creatura ibrida al servizio della città contro un malvagio gatto arancione.

programme.title: Smallfoot: Il mio amico delle nevi
programme.desc: Formidabile favola d’animazione che cambia il punto di vista di un’antica leggenda. Migo è un giovane Yeti che vive con il resto della comunità in una città innevata, al di sopra delle nuvole in cima all’Himalaya. Un giorno assiste a un incidente aereo e scopre che il pilota è un essere umano: una specie da sempre considerata un’invenzione. Di ritorno dai suoi simili nessuno gli crede, ma un regista di documentari che da sempre è alla ricerca dell’esistenza del popolo Yeti accetta di seguire Migo fino al suo villaggio per dimostrare che le due specie non sono una leggenda per creduloni.

programme.desc: Gioco pericoloso.

Dopo aver commesso un imperdonabile errore, un giovane e ambizioso impiegato di una multinazionale ha la possibilita' di riabilitarsi agli occhi del suo capo e salvare il posto. Ma il boss in realta' lo ricatta, costringendolo a farsi assumere dalla societa' concorrente per rubare il prototipo di un nuovo prodotto. Dalla padella nella brace, si accorgera' di essere la semplice pedina di uno sporco gioco.

Una giovane popstar, perseguitata da esasperanti allucinazioni e divorata dalla paura, deve trovare una via di fuga da una terrificante entità maligna con il potere di spostarsi di persona in persona.

programme.desc: Fantasy di M. Night Shyamalan con Paul Giamatti e Bryce Dallas Howard. Proveniente dal mondo delle fiabe, una misteriosa creatura emerge dalle acque di una piscina condominiale.

programme.desc: Johnny Depp nella storia vera di un gangster della droga. Anni '70: George Jung diventa il punto di riferimento negli USA per il traffico di cocaina del cartello di Pablo Escobar.

programme.desc: Thriller ricco di suspense con Dylan O'Brien, prodotto da M. Night Shyamalan. Quando la piccola Anna scompare misteriosamente nei pressi di un lago, inizia una disperata ricerca.

programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

Ma Ike non si da' per vinto e decide di fare un viaggio fino nel Maryland per scoprire la verita'.

programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Jane Austen, una storia di intese amorose con Gwyneth Paltrow. 1800: una giovane aristocratica inglese aiuta una ragazza timida a trovare l'uomo giusto. Oscar alle musiche.

Il ragazzo vorrebbe che lei lo raggiungesse, ma Sophie non vuole lasciare l'isola per non mancare di rispetto alla madre, Donna, scomparsa un anno prima. Alla vigilia dell'inaugurazione dell'albergo, tuttavia, un violento uragano si abbatte su Kalokairi.

programme.desc: Golden Globe a Kevin Bacon per un'appassionante pellicola tratta da una storia vera. Il colonnello Michael Strobl si offre di riportare a casa la salma di un giovane soldato ucciso in Iraq.

programme.desc: Marcello Fonte, premiato a Cannes, ed Edoardo Pesce nel film di Matteo Garrone ispirato a un fatto di cronaca. Periferia di Roma: un mite toelettatore reagisce ai soprusi del suo aguzzino.

Segnato dalla morte della figlia, Howard, un pubblicitario di New York, si chiude in se stesso perdendo ogni interesse per cio' che lo circonda. L'unica sua reazione concreta consiste nella scrittura di lettere indirizzate alla Morte, al Tempo e all'Amore. Ai suoi amici non resta che assecondarlo mentre escogitano un piano per aiutarlo a riprendere in mano la propria vita. Dal regista de "Il diavolo veste Prada". Cast da tappeto rosso: Edward Norton, Keira Knightley, Naomie Harris e i premi Oscar Helen Mirren e Kate Winslet.

Tony D'Amato e i suoi Miami Sharks perdono una partita dietro l'altra, il quarterback titolare e' fuori per infortunio e la giovane e affascinante proprietaria della squadra e' decisa a far fuori il coach. Ma mandarlo via non e' per nulla facile, la squadra e' con Tony e tra un problema e l'altro riesce a qualificarsi per i playoff. Dentro o fuori, non ci sono alternative.

It brings together six Special Force units to compete in challenging missions across land, sea, and air. Top female reservists form teams of four to compete against one another. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: The Foggy Mountain
programme.desc: Phi, a veteran boxer, sets out on a quest for revenge after the ruthless crime lord Ba Rau killed his wife. His journey takes him into the remote village near Foggy Mountain, where he discovers Ba Rau's human trafficking activities. The final showdown is inevitable as Phi must take down Ba Rau to save the villagers and avenge his wife’s death.

programme.title: Iron Ball
programme.desc: This sports entertainment show brings the best special forces from Iron Squad to take on a new challenge – dodgeball. The 26 players will enter a fierce competition, until a strongest team armed with powerful athletic endurance and mental strength is formed. Witness how they compete in front of the star athletes and legendary dodgeball coaches!

programme.title: 10 Fight 10 Season 3
programme.desc: The show brings Thai superstars, singers, boxers, models and rappers into the celebrity boxing ring. programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist

programme.desc: Fernando Poe Jr. stars as Carding Villamar, a city professional who returns to their hometown of Evangelista after learning of his brother's untimely demise. As a series of events unfold, he soon discovers that his brother didn't succumb to a heart attack as he was made to believe. He was shot in cold blood for refusing to sell his land to a powerful congressman. With a town muted and crippled by fear, the congressman's henchmen move unhampered to silence Carding and his brother's orphaned family as well. Big mistake. Armed with only a crusty riffle and a whole ton of rage. Carding sets out to right the wrong and exact vengeance for the murder of his brother. That is, if he survives the hot pursuits of bounty hunters, the militia and the police who are all in the congressman's payroll.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S1 1
programme.desc: Former boxer Brandon Bernier and his wife Lori target the best storage units in America and then to go to any lengths to get their hands on what's stashed inside.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S1 2

Then, Jesse one ups the competition for a locker with a multi-thousand dollar payout. And later, a booby-trapped unit explodes, sending shockwaves through the storage facility.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S2 1

Then, a vintage motorcycle and rare car parts create big cash for one of our slickest auction heroes. And later, the Taylor Brothers are in for the fight of their lives when they leave the Deep South for the promise of California gold. It's an old-world battle that could lead to a new world order.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S2 2
programme.desc: The competition heats up as Brandon and Lori find themselves in an all out bidding war with the tough-talking Taylor brothers. Amidst the chaos, Jesse goes all-in for a locker that could be hiding an expert marksman's rare weapons. And later, Sean unveils a bin whose stench is so rancid it sends the buyers running. But when one of our competitors takes a gamble, the entire group is blown away by the score.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S2 3
programme.desc: Our buyers go to war to win a locker packed with valuable vintage surf gear. Then, Brandon and Lori get stuck with a busted bin, but when they find a glass case filled with an unidentifiable goo, they're left wondering if this unit smells like moneyor just plain stinks. And later, the day's final auction unleashes a bidding war so medieval, someone will have to be carted away.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S2 4
programme.desc: Our buyers throw down to score a locker packed with rare movie memorabilia. Then, Papa Bear and T-Money each scoop up low-grade bins, but when they each start to sift through their individual messes, one of them finds a childhood dream-come-true. Andlater, the day's final auction sparks an intense bidding war, but when one of our buyers shoots the moon on his bid, it leaves everyone else wondering exactly where all of this cash is coming from.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S2 5
programme.desc: Our buyers lock horns to win a unit packed with valuable construction equipment. Then, Brandon and Lori spot something that no one else does, but they'll have to play it cool if they want to walk away with this golden score. And later, the day's final locker smells of gas and cash, but leads to a showdown that gets one of our buyers banned from the auction.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S2 6
programme.desc: Minds are blown when two of our buyers team up for a major score. It's an unlikely pair that, together, could make a pile of cash. Plus, Jesse takes a big gamble on some African art and sweats it out hard when the authenticity is questioned. And later, the day's final auction reveals contents so shocking our buyers may be shut out of this game completely.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S2 7
programme.desc: Brandon and Jesse lock horns in a do or die bidding war. One of them spies an authentic treasure hidden amongst the contents, but only one will walk away with the score. And later, a newbie steals a prize unit out from under our regulars and proves that she's here to play. Then, Brandon and Lori unearth a five-alarm find. If it works, they could be looking at a $20,000 pay day on this item alone.

programme.desc: Our buyers bid big to win a locker packed with what looks like rare art, but will the winner walk away with cash or counterfeits? Then, a dumpy unit sends almost everyone running, but Papa Bear spies a profit. And later, the day's final auction contains expensive looking sky-diving equipment that ignites a sky-high bidding war. programme.title: The Man With The Iron Fists
programme.desc: Saat berburu harta karun emas, sekelompok prajurit, pembunuh, dan seorang pembelot asal Inggris pergi ke sebuah desa di Tiongkok dan bertemu seorang pandai besi baik hati yang tengah berjuang mempertahankan desanya.

programme.title: Gangs Of New York
programme.desc: Pada tahun 1863, Amsterdam Vallon kembali ke area Five Points di Kota New York untuk membalas dendam pada Bill The Butcher yang telah membunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Hancock
programme.desc: Seorang superhero tiba di Sheepshead Bay, Brooklyn, dan mencoba untuk mewarnai kehidupannya dengan merayu seorang ibu rumah tangga yang memikat. Namun hal ini justru menyebabkan kekacauan di kota itu.

programme.title: Jurassic World
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli hewan militer turun tangan saat suatu taman hiburan yang berisi sekawanan dinosaurus hasil rekayasa genetika berubah mengerikan bagi para wisatawan karena salah satu dinosaurus lepas dari kandang.

programme.title: Collateral
programme.desc: Seorang pengemudi taksi disandera oleh seorang pembunuh bayaran yang melakukan serangkaian aksi pembunuhan selama satu malam di LA, dan ia harus menemukan cara untuk menyelamatkan diri dan satu korban terakhir.

programme.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programme.desc: Eric dan Sara merupakan anggota pasukan Ratu Es Freya yang berusaha menyembunyikan cinta terlarang mereka saat keduanya berjuang melawan niat jahat dari Freya dan juga saudara perempuannya, Ravenna.

programme.title: Hancock

programme.title: Hotel Transylvania 2
programme.desc: Hotel Transylvania dipenuhi oleh perpaduan antara kekuatan supranatural lama dan modern yang keren saat vampir tua nan kuno Vlad tiba di hotel untuk acara kumpul keluarga dadakan.

programme.title: Anacondas: Hunt For Blood...
programme.desc: Sekelompok ilmuwan menerjang bahaya yang ada di hutan hujan untuk mencari bunga yang mengandung serum awet muda.

programme.desc: Sesosok siborg nan identik dengan siborg yang gagal membunuh Sarah Connor kini harus melindungi putranya yang berusia sepuluh tahun, John, dari siborg lain yang lebih canggih dan kuat.

programme.title: The Suicide Squad
programme.desc: A group of misfits are coerced to work together for a dangerous mission in Corto Maltese. Despite their differences, they learn to trust each other and collaborate as a team.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood
programme.desc: A Vietnam War veteran arrives in a small town but faces hostility from the local sheriff, leading to a tense conflict where survival instincts and combat skills take over.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: A prosecutor commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: New power dynamics emerge amongst the survivors of the second ice age when they board a train travelling across the globe.

programme.title: Hollywood on Set
programme.desc: The key aspects of filmmaking are explored, with behind-the-scenes insights and intriguing interviews with prominent cast and crew members.

programme.title: DSC
programme.desc: Talented directors provide an entertaining insight into the most intriguing stories and anecdotes concerning some of their best works.

programme.title: Force of Execution
programme.desc: A gangster, who seeks to retire from the life of crime, faces a threat when an upcoming rival challenges his authority. He then decides to take help from a trustworthy former apprentice.

programme.title: Recoil
programme.desc: When his family is killed by a notorious gang, Ryan Varett, a former police officer, suits up to seek revenge against the perpetrators.

programme.title: Tracers
programme.desc: Cam, a bike messenger, is wanted by the Chinese mafia and he is on the run while learning parkour after crashing into a beautiful woman.

programme.title: Born to Fight
programme.desc: Dan Barnes, a former professional boxer, takes up the responsibility to coach Matthew Miller, a teenager who is repeatedly bullied by a school boxing champion and his friends.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: Megan Walsh, a special agent, is curious about teenage life experiences so she fakes her own death and enrols in high school. Soon, she realises the troubles of the high school life.

programme.title: Resident Evil: Extinction
programme.desc: During a zombie apocalypse engineered by the Umbrella Corporation, Alice and a group of survivors journey across the country in search of supplies and a safe place.

programme.title: Bumblebee
programme.desc: During the Cybertron Civil War, Optimus Prime sends Autobot scout B-127 to Earth to form a base where they can regroup. Later, the scout befriends a girl named Charlie, who names him Bumblebee.

programme.title: Quantum of Solace
programme.desc: James Bond follows Dominic Greene, a prominent developer of green technology, to stop him from aiding a deadly mission to stage a coup in Bolivia.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: Detective James Carter and Chief Inspector Lee return to action after a bomb explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: After being abandoned at a fair, Billy constantly searches for his mother. His life, however, takes a huge turn when he inherits superpowers from a powerful wizard.

programme.title: Black Adam
programme.desc: After being granted the divine power of the Egyptian Gods and spending almost 5000 years in a guardhouse, Black Adam is freed and decides to unleash his style of justice on the world.
